claims.statement: Database backups (.theb) are exported as gzipped tar archives containing a JSON manifest and a SQLite database snapshot produced via the SQLite Online Backup API with atomic temporary file renaming.

Restoring a .theb backup enforces strict safety guarantees: it always restores to a new tree file, validates archive contents, checks forward schema compatibility before touching the destination, and regenerates tree copy IDs upon collision with existing trees.
Lossless portability packages (.tgpkg) are GEDZIP-compatible ZIP archives containing a package manifest, GEDCOM-7 tree text (tree.ged), an evidence SQLite database snapshot, and a media directory.
Package imports distinguish between full packages and delta packages against baseline copy IDs, providing preview metrics such as individual and source document counts.
